import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

sns.set(style="whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='Stress Level', palette='viridis', alpha=0.6)
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep Colored by Stress Level')
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (scale)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
